rubrics.justification: Accurately interprets the provided Gardner score 1DD as very poor-quality blastocyst with degenerative/absent ICM and TE, but no image was available and it adds little morphology beyond the score.
Integrates age, ovarian reserve, PCOS, sperm parameters, endometrium, and lifestyle with embryo prognosis well, though some statements are somewhat generalized.
Reasoning is clear and internally consistent: severe DD morphology drives the very poor prognosis despite otherwise favorable uterine and semen factors.

Mostly consistent with Gardner grading and general IVF practice, but calling age 37 'not advanced maternal age' is inaccurate and recommending absolute non-viability/cancel transfer is stronger than guideline-based caution would support.

Provides practical counseling points, transfer discussion, and future-cycle review steps including protocol review and consideration of PGT-A, though some recommendations are broader than case-specific evidence supports.
